units.sourceHTML: 10.12 patch and the POSIX Standard

units.text: If you specify the ⟦0⟧ option, or set the ⟦1⟧ environment variable, ⟦2⟧ conforms more strictly to the POSIX standard, as follows:
units.sourceHTML: If you specify the --posix option, or set the POSIXLY_CORRECT environment variable, patch conforms more strictly to the POSIX standard, as follows:

units.text: Take the first existing file from the list (old, new, index) when intuiting file names from diff headers. See ⟦0⟧Multiple Patches in a File⟦1⟧.
units.sourceHTML: • Take the first existing file from the list (old, new, index) when intuiting file names from diff headers. See Multiple Patches in a File.

units.text: Do not remove files that are removed by a diff. See ⟦0⟧Creating and Removing Files⟦1⟧.
units.sourceHTML: • Do not remove files that are removed by a diff. See Creating and Removing Files.

units.text: Do not ask whether to get files from RCS, ClearCase, or SCCS. See ⟦0⟧Revision Control⟦1⟧.
units.sourceHTML: • Do not ask whether to get files from RCS, ClearCase, or SCCS. See Revision Control.

units.text: Require that all options precede the files in the command line.
units.sourceHTML: • Require that all options precede the files in the command line.

units.text: Do not backup files, even when there is a mismatch. See ⟦0⟧Backup Files⟦1⟧.
units.sourceHTML: • Do not backup files, even when there is a mismatch. See Backup Files.
